about_the_game:
Train and battle your way to the top in PLATE!

Customize your PLATE and face off against fierce competition in strategic combat.

Build your PLATE your way.
Design your PLATE to match your playstyle. Create a glass cannon with devastating one-hit K.O. power or craft a nimble, defensive PLATE that excels through speed and outlasts opponents with precision strikes. The choice is yours!

Train for victory.
Manage health, stamina, and other vital resources to maintain a steady training routine. Achieve peak performance and elevate your combat effectiveness, ensuring you're always prepared for the toughest challenges.

Engage in innovative, real-time combat.
Quick reflexes and strategic resource management are the keys to success. Every battle tests your ability to adapt, react, and outthink your foes.

Endless Replayability.
Each playthrough features procedurally generated enemies with unique stats and abilities, ensuring that no two runs are ever the same. Adapt to the unexpected and rise to the challenge!
